sic_snapshot.role: shared Worker teaching, mode-I activation, CB prefix rendering
editor request contract, sic_edit_blocks schema, config freeze
seven operations, PVI, validation and materialization
program rules, bounded scheduling, per-WB budget consumption
synthetic exact-fact retention scorer (not a real quality evaluator)

sic_contract.editor_delivery: exactly one tool call with ops and pvi; unmentioned units default to KEEP
sic_contract.pvi: P (persistent), V (volatile pending), I (instant activation) are separated; V becomes pending source material

worker_teaching.scope: shared Worker SIC teaching and CB navigation

editor_mode.boundary: Editor may activate only sic_edit_blocks and must not execute the task

worker_mode.boundary: Worker may not call sic_edit_blocks and uses only authorized tools

program_rules.note: deterministic rule package; zero model calls

adaptation.adopted: checkpoint handoff sections: progress, constraints, remaining steps, critical references; explicit next-LLM audience
adaptation.rejected: single mutable summary as the only artifact; SIC keeps immutable CBs and ordered ops
adaptation.difference: SIC Editor returns sic_edit_blocks ops with default KEEP and PVI; a summary-like compression is one COMPRESS/REPLACE choice, not the whole protocol

adaptation.adopted: summary framing is explicit and separable from generated content
adaptation.rejected: prefix alone cannot establish traceability; SIC binds frozen Editor snapshot and candidate revision
adaptation.difference: SIC records editor_source_snapshot_ids, candidate revision and program KEEP provenance

adaptation.adopted: deterministic LastNObservations / ClosedWindow / RemoveRegex baselines, zero model calls
adaptation.rejected: dropping old observations without an edit record
adaptation.difference: SIC DELETE/FLAG/REPLACE are explicit, target-addressed, and replayable; late material is not claimed as Editor-seen

adaptation.adopted: deterministic relevance selection as a non-LLM baseline (PageRank/tree-sitter)
adaptation.rejected: repo-map relevance as a substitute for conversational WB/CB state
adaptation.difference: SIC material is WB/CB hierarchy with source anchors, not a repository symbol graph

adaptation.rejected: unstructured token deletion; no target/op/PVI record
adaptation.difference: SIC compression is an ordered operation on units with PVI and validation; program KEEP closes late material

model_freeze.note: No paid provider call was made for this preparation package.
